patches.summary: Clear fully accepted cloned input lists before origin remainder return.
removes: Clear fully accepted cloned input lists before origin remainder return.
preserves: Native overflow/remainder behavior.

patches.summary: Suppress native instant catch-up for a captured/applied party that has not reached a valid handoff.
removes: Suppress native instant catch-up for a captured/applied party that has not reached a valid handoff.
preserves: Uncaptured/native fallback.
Existing routes and combat exclusions.
Toggles.

patches.summary: Manage eligible real freight chronologically, suppress its duplicated native FFWD and replay due dispatch opportunities.
removes: Manage eligible real freight chronologically, suppress its duplicated native FFWD and replay due dispatch opportunities.
preserves: PASS has no cargo market and is excluded.
Loaded, combat, connected and unprepared freight retain native paths.
Native production/dispatch choices and rollback.

patches.summary: Stop and unregister uncrewed execution without introducing a stale disposal marker.
removes: Stop and unregister uncrewed execution without introducing a stale disposal marker.
preserves: Existing stale status.
Crewed traffic and legitimate police boarding exception.

patches.summary: Invalidate a removed ship goal and old course; native behavior resumes.
removes: Invalidate a removed ship goal and old course; native behavior resumes.
preserves: Live hidden destinations.
Independent coordinate/stellar goals, including native representation conversion.
No forced route or station-return policy.

patches.summary: Resolve target lifetimes after native asteroid Ship-to-stellar conversion; preserve successful logical destinations and clean up real failure.
removes: Transient Ship destruction no longer invalidates a surviving stellar goal.
preserves: Native unmooring and stellar creation.
Independent/copied waypoints, existing routes, fuel and momentum.
Failed conversion remains real destination removal; exceptions and nested scopes retain native behavior.

patches.summary: Use actual Y for the second regional-station coordinate in both native civilian FFWD branches.
removes: X/X lookup can select a different regional station from X/Y.
preserves: Native candidate selection, remembered partners, docking eligibility and outcomes.
Existing-route handling, attached/empty Hold and all nonregional target paths.

patches.summary: Extend the native player-connection exemption to hull destruction; temporarily use native global scheduling, then restore physical regional membership at queue refill after detachment.
removes: Unconditional destruction after skipping player-connected crew relocation and undocking.
Retained controllers becoming unscheduled or permanently global after detachment.
preserves: Native recursive ownership/docking predicate and station-body handling.
Same controller, crew, pilot, home, orders, routes, motion and fuel; no forced departure.
Native queue priority, genuine interregional freight and primitive save serialization.
Unregistered crewless captures retain native derelict cleanup protection without inventing a controller.

patches.summary: Reject new hidden civilian rendezvous; invalidate retired/restored ordinary visits, defer to native combat/priority ownership, and protect physical civilian encounters from retirement.
removes: Selecting administrative reserve/vendor hulls as new space rendezvous.
Continuing a retired/reused ordinary visit with its obsolete route and fuel estimate.
Retiring a hull while a civilian encounter remains physically attached.
preserves: Native Main children, order, sticky/save paths and random/low-fuel selection.
Combat, reaction, queued/explicit commands, passenger/freight destinations and player navigation.
Motion and spent fuel; visible empty/derelict visits and detached reserve supply.
Native station-only parking and hauler tow-delivery retirement.

patches.summary: Unsaved registration reuses an existing controller across regions rather than enrolling the same hull under a second role.
removes: Cross-region collision fallback creating an additional local controller for an active interregional freighter.
preserves: Original role, region, home, behavior/blackboard state, route, fuel and manifest.
Native fallback creation when no controller exists and explicit saved/player-autopilot setup.

documentedDependencies.reason: Tests/OrbitalCheck/EconomyChecks executes event ordering, loading, partial trips and delivery; this role model does not calculate physics or production recipes.
TargetLifecycle models permanent removal and reconstruction. Traffic adds the missing Ship-to-stellar conversion interleaving.
StationReturn is an optional saved directive using native FlyTo/Dock; ordinary cargo Main and market loading do not imply it.
People may transfer during a nonstation visit; character-level pledges, permissions and agendas remain native. No prisoner-transfer policy is inferred.

ApplySaveData removes only the unique original INTERREGIONAL cargo plus local Scav/Police fallback pattern with matching native cargo ownership/origin. Native restore and unchanged captured payloads are tested; ambiguous histories/missing hulls and historical orphan refunds are excluded.
